title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for Prospective Students
content: Answers to common queries: What is the college cutoff for Computer Engineering? (Typically 95+ percentile in MHT-CET). Is hostel accommodation guaranteed for outstation students? (Yes, on first-come-first-served basis). Are education loans available? (Yes, nationalized banks offer on-campus loan sanction facilities). What is the attendance policy? (Minimum 75% attendance is compulsory).
